messages.subject: Error
parts:
Hello 
I am trying to run a Non-mixture cure survival model in r nimble, with zero trick in order to define the likelihood of mixture cure model but in defining model step i encountered a error that say "There are multiple definitions for nodes:zeros[1],zeros[2],...." actually zeros is the zero trick in bugs language

zeros[i]<-0
phi[i]<- -log(l[i])+c
zeros[i]~dpois(phi[i])

that l[i] is my likelihood. i would be appreciated if anybody could help me. 
Thank you
--
Amir Teimourpour
PhD student in Biostatistics

messages.author: dd632bd3bbcdd7e9
messages.subject: Re: Error
parts:
Hi Amir,

It looks like the "zeros[i] <- 0" needs to be removed and you need to pass a vector of 0s in the zeros variable as part of your data list when you call nimbleModel (or, later, when you use setData for your model).

On the other hand, often the zeros trick is not needed in nimble because you can write new distributions.

-Perry
